Recorded read-only from bench daemons (offline seeded set: seeding, stopped, downloading, queued, finished, local-error; labels movies/tv on >=16; two .invalid trackers per torrent).
rpc-15 = 2.94 (rpc 15), rpc-16 = 3.00 (rpc 16), rpc-17 = 4.0.6 (rpc 17, semver 5.3.0), rpc-41 = 4.1.3 (rpc 19, semver 6.0.1, 409 header X-Transmission-Rpc-Version present).
Each file: {_source, request, response}; handshake-409.json holds the X-Transmission-Rpc-* headers of the 409 (empty below 4.1).
Known gap: on rpc-16 the error-foxtrot torrent did not reach the local-error state (status 3, error 0); the other three versions carry error 3 "No data found!".
